request.description:
**Rate limit:** `login`.

Returns next_step `authenticated` with tokens and admin, or `verify_otp` with a challenge when APFSPN_ADMIN_TWO_FACTOR is on. Errors: invalid_credentials (401), account_disabled (403), must_reset_password (403).

request.description:
**Rate limit:** `otp`.

Use after Login when next_step is verify_otp (APFSPN_ADMIN_TWO_FACTOR on). Sends the login challenge and the emailed code; returns tokens, saved to admin_token and admin_refresh_token. The same URL also verifies reset codes: see "Forgot password: verify OTP". Errors: invalid_otp, otp_expired, stale_challenge_token, otp_blocked, invalid_challenge_token.

item.name: Admin Dashboard
item.description: The admin landing page. Needs an admin access token (admin_token) with dashboard.view. Each section is included only when the admin holds its permission; sections are cached for 60 seconds and cleared when members, events, articles or audit rows change.

request.description:
**Auth:** admin access token.

**Permission:** `dashboard.view`.

Sections: members (members.view): counts_by_status, pending_approvals, new_registrations.this_week/this_month (calendar week from Monday and calendar month in Africa/Lagos). events: upcoming (events.view; next 5 published events with seats_left, null when unlimited) and registrations_this_week (event_registrations.view). articles (articles.view): counts_by_status and awaiting_review {total, items: 5 oldest in review}. recent_activity (audit_logs.view): last 10 audit entries with action, description, admin, subject and created_at. A section the admin cannot view is left out rather than returned as null.
